Hi team,

I just finished the quickstart tutorial on your docs CTA and wanted to see whether we could get a short technical onboarding. We're evaluating inference options for an experimental feature at Flicker.ai and I'd like to cover latency expectations, embedding cost tradeoffs, and deployment options (hosted vs dedicated).

Preferred times: mornings ET (9–11am) this week.

Thanks —

(taylor@flicker.ai)

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed 10/06 09:30 PT / 12:30 ET
- Wed 10/06 11:00 PT / 14:00 ET

If none of those work, feel free to pick a time on my calendar: https://cal.redwood.ai/j/jonas-30min. I'll attach a short quickstart PDF and send a calendar invite once we confirm.

Also: are there any constraints we should know (VPC/networking, data residency, blocked cloud providers)?

Best,
